articles.title: Microsoft Adds $450 Billion in One Day, Smashing U.S. Market Cap Record
articles.excerpt: Shares surged 15.5% after blowout earnings showed Azure cloud growth accelerating and AI investments beginning to pay off, easing Wall Street fears about Big Tech spending.
articles.nri_angle: Microsoft employs tens of thousands of Indian-origin tech workers and its cloud and AI growth directly impacts Indian IT services firms like Infosys and TCS that are key Azure partners.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Japan and South Korea Stage Rare Joint Currency Intervention as Yen Surges 3%
articles.excerpt: The coordinated move sent the yen to its strongest level in six months, while the Bank of Japan held rates steady at 1% and the U.S. Treasury called the currency 'very undervalued.'
articles.image_caption: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda has overseen the central bank's historic policy shift
articles.nri_angle: A stronger yen affects Indian IT exports to Japan and signals broader shifts in emerging-market currencies, including the rupee.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Amazon Revenue Hits $201 Billion as AWS Posts Fastest Growth in 18 Quarters
articles.excerpt: Cloud unit revenue surged 37% to $42.2 billion, beating estimates by a wide margin, as Amazon raised its 2026 capex outlook to $220 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Amazon is a major holding for Indian diaspora investors; AWS growth signals continued AI infrastructure demand that benefits Indian IT services firms.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rivian Beats Revenue Estimates, Raises Delivery Outlook as R2 SUV Gains Traction
articles.excerpt: The EV maker posted $1.66 billion in Q2 revenue, a 27% jump, while its mass-market R2 SUV drove higher delivery guidance and a path toward positive gross margins.
articles.nri_angle: Rivian's strong quarter and growing software business—bolstered by its Volkswagen joint venture—signal opportunities for investors tracking the EV sector's evolution amid shifting U.S. policy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Citadel Buys Situational Awareness Stock Portfolio After AI Fund's Collapse
articles.excerpt: Ken Griffin's hedge fund acquires the leveraged portion of Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI-focused portfolio after the former OpenAI researcher's fund was battered by July's tech selloff, triggering relief buying across Wall Street.
articles.nri_angle: Major AI stock selloff and hedge fund dynamics affect global investors including those tracking US tech markets from abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Markets Open Flat as Fed Holds Rates and FII Selling Extends to Third Session
articles.excerpt: Sensex and Nifty trade cautiously amid mixed global cues, with IT stocks showing strength while consumer durables and realty drag.
articles.nri_angle: Fed rate decisions directly affect NRI investment flows and rupee-denominated returns on Indian market holdings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Zepto Targets $3 Billion IPO Valuation, Less Than Half Its Peak
articles.excerpt: The quick-commerce startup has begun anchor investor discussions at a sharp markdown from its $7 billion private valuation, with a possible delay looming if the gap with institutional buyers can't be bridged.
articles.nri_angle: Zepto's $7 billion-to-$3 billion valuation slide is a cautionary signal for NRI investors in India's private startup market, highlighting the widening gap between late-stage private pricing and what public markets will actually pay.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Banks Collected Over Rs 7,000 Crore From Account Holders for Low Balance Penalties in FY26
articles.excerpt: The practice continues to burden small depositors despite several public sector banks waiving minimum balance charges in the past year.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs maintaining Indian bank accounts face minimum balance penalties that can quietly drain dormant accounts, making the policy personally relevant to the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Toyota Launches 9th-Generation Hilux in India Starting at Rs 31.99 Lakh
articles.excerpt: The iconic pickup truck gets a bold 'Cyber Sumo' redesign, a first-ever 4x2 variant, and a cabin packed with new tech — with test drives beginning July 29.
articles.nri_angle: The Hilux offers NRIs a globally proven, Toyota-backed pickup option for Indian farmland, weekend properties, or adventure travel.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: L&T Profit Rises 14% as India's Q1 Earnings Season Delivers Mixed Signals
articles.excerpt: Larsen & Toubro and Radico Khaitan post strong growth, but Hindustan Unilever and Suzlon Energy see profit dip as geopolitical headwinds weigh on select sectors.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking India corporate earnings; domestic consumption and infrastructure narrative remains intact despite global headwinds
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nasdaq 100 Enters Correction Territory as AI Spending Fears and China's Chip Breakthrough Rattle Markets
articles.excerpt: The tech-heavy index fell 10% from its June peak as a chip stock rout deepened on concerns over massive AI capital expenditure and reports of Chinese semiconductor advances.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors with US tech exposure face portfolio implications; Nifty IT index companies could see pressure if AI spending pullback extends to enterprise budgets
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Pakistan's Business Community Alleges Silent Visa Ban by UAE as Export Losses Mount
articles.excerpt: Pakistani officials confirm the UAE has halted most visa issuance for its nationals, threatening $6.3 billion in annual remittances and disrupting bilateral trade.
articles.image_caption: Pakistan's business community has raised alarms over what it calls a silent visa ban by the UAE, with export losses mounting since March 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Gulf visa restrictions affect all South Asian expatriate communities; India's 3.5 million UAE diaspora watches as policy shifts can reshape communities overnight
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Board Fines CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan Over Deposit Pricing Overreach
articles.excerpt: India's largest private lender concludes its internal review of the MSRDC deposit arrangement, finding business overreach but no misconduct or personal enrichment.
articles.image_caption: Sashidhar Jagdishan, CEO of HDFC Bank. The bank's board imposed a financial penalty on him over a deposit pricing dispute.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is the largest private bank in India and a major holding in most NRI investment portfolios and mutual funds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's NRI Deposit Drive May Hit $70 Billion as Banks Shatter 2013 Record in Just 45 Days
articles.excerpt: SBI Research sharply raises FCNR(B) projections as total RBI-linked forex inflows could reach $85 billion, potentially swinging India's balance of payments to a $50 billion surplus.
articles.image_caption: India's NRI deposit drive has attracted record inflows as banks offer higher rates on foreign currency deposits.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can earn up to 6.5% on dollar deposits through FCNR(B) schemes, with leveraged returns potentially exceeding 20% — a direct investment opportunity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Sons Posts ₹32,000 Crore Profit in FY26 as Air India Losses Balloon to Record Levels
articles.excerpt: The Tata holding company's standalone profit surged 22% to ₹32,000 crore, but Air India's estimated ₹22,000 crore loss and a leadership vacuum at the airline cast a shadow over the recovery.
articles.nri_angle: Air India's service disruptions and costlier rerouted flights directly affect the Indian diaspora, particularly on high-traffic US, UK, and Gulf routes that connect families across continents.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Jobs Paradox: Two in Three Unemployed Youth Are Now Graduates
articles.excerpt: Azim Premji University's State of Working India 2026 report reveals that graduate unemployment has remained stuck between 35 and 40 percent for four decades, even as India produces five million graduates a year.
articles.image_caption: Indian university graduates at a convocation ceremony. A new report finds nearly 40 percent of graduates aged 15 to 25 are unemployed.
articles.nri_angle: Stagnant graduate employment outcomes and rising credentialism raise questions about the returns on education investments many diaspora families help fund for relatives in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AU Small Finance Bank Raises NRI Deposit Rates Amid India's Record Dollar Drive
articles.excerpt: The bank hiked FCNR rates to 7.10% and introduced zero-cost remittances as part of a broader RBI-backed push that has drawn $32 billion in foreign currency inflows.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn up to 7.10% on dollar deposits with zero forex charges on remittances, a sharp improvement from rates below 5.15% just weeks earlier.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 45% of Indian Exports to the US Escape New 10% Tariff as Commerce Ministry Points to Pharma and Smartphone Exemptions
articles.excerpt: India says it secured a lower tariff rate than most countries under the US Section 301 forced-labour investigation, but textile exporters warn the new duties put them at a disadvantage against Asian rivals.
articles.nri_angle: The new tariff regime directly affects Indian businesses and diaspora entrepreneurs engaged in US-India trade, particularly in textiles, chemicals and manufactured goods.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Manipal Health's Rs 9,275-Crore IPO Leads Packed Week on Dalal Street With Nine Offerings and Seven Listings
articles.excerpt: India's primary market enters its busiest stretch of the year as Temasek-backed Manipal Health opens on July 29, Indo-MIM nears listing with strong subscription and several SME issues launch.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking Indian markets face a packed IPO calendar with healthcare and precision manufacturing offerings providing exposure to India's growth story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Five Triggers That Could Move Indian Markets This Week: Fed Decision, Q1 Earnings and Oil Prices
articles.excerpt: From the US Federal Reserve's rate decision to the ongoing West Asia conflict, here are the key forces Dalal Street is watching in the last week of July.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors face concentrated risk this week as the Fed decision, oil prices and Q1 earnings all converge to test India's premium market valuation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Governor Says Rupee Is Undervalued as FCNR(B) Inflows Cross $32 Billion
articles.excerpt: Sanjay Malhotra dismisses deposit recycling concerns and says the central bank has 'foolproof' hedging against currency risk from the inflow drive.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs driving FCNR(B) deposit surge with attractive rates; RBI governor reassures on rupee stability and deposit safety
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IDFC First Bank Profit Surges 132% as AU Small Finance Bank Shows Recovery in Q1
articles.excerpt: Both mid-tier Indian lenders posted strong Q1 FY27 results, with IDFC First Bank’s net profit more than doubling to ₹1,075 crore and AU Small Finance Bank reporting a 37% jump to ₹796 crore on improving asset quality.
articles.nri_angle: IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank are widely held by NRI investors and both banks improved earnings signal strengthening fundamentals in India mid-tier banking sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India to Launch Unified Customer ID for Banks and Insurers in August
articles.excerpt: The CKYC 2.0 system will let financial institutions pull verified customer data from a central registry with consent, eliminating repeated KYC paperwork. Mutual funds and brokerages are expected to join later this year.
articles.image_caption: India's financial regulators plan to launch a unified customer identification system for banks and insurers in August
articles.nri_angle: CKYC 2.0 could simplify remote KYC for NRIs managing Indian bank accounts, insurance, and investments from abroad by replacing repeated document submissions with a consent-based digital verification system.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nasdaq Drops 2.1% for the Week as AI Spending Fears Hammer Memory Chip Stocks
articles.excerpt: Alphabet's capital spending surge spooked investors ahead of megacap earnings, while falling oil prices offered Wall Street partial relief.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech workers and NRI investors with heavy exposure to AI and chip stocks are directly affected by the valuation re-rating.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Moody's Warns AI Spending Threatens Big Tech Credit as Google's Cash Flow Turns Negative
articles.excerpt: Hyperscaler capital expenditure is set to reach $785 billion this year and close in on $1 trillion by 2027, as Google reports the first negative free cash flow in its history as a public company.
articles.image_caption: Moody's has warned that surging AI infrastructure spending could pressure Big Tech credit ratings as companies like Google see free cash flow turn negative.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT services firms benefit from the AI infrastructure boom but face risk if hyperscaler spending contracts. Indian tech workers in Silicon Valley are also exposed to any correction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Imposes 'Forced Labor' Tariffs on 60 Nations as Global Levy Expires
articles.excerpt: New duties of 10% to 12.5% cover virtually all U.S. imports under Section 301, replacing the temporary global surcharge at the exact moment it lapsed.
articles.nri_angle: India faces the lower 10% tariff rate for having forced labor import bans, but a second Section 301 probe into excess manufacturing capacity could add more duties, while Indian-American importers benefit from exemptions on critical minerals and foodstuffs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rocket Lab Lands $266 Million Air Force Contract as Defense Wins Stack Up
articles.excerpt: The launch company secured a firm-fixed-price deal for 12 suborbital missions using its HASTE rocket, days after being selected for a $17 billion Space Force program.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers make up a significant portion of the U.S. aerospace workforce, and Rocket Lab's growing defense portfolio reflects the broader space economy that many diaspora professionals are building careers in.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tech Millionaires Are Reshaping the Luxury Market With Meteorites, Dinosaurs and Fire Trucks
articles.excerpt: An estimated 440,000 new U.S. millionaires minted by AI and SpaceX windfalls are splashing out on unconventional collectibles, upending traditional luxury brands' playbooks.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech professionals are among the largest beneficiaries of Silicon Valley and AI-era wealth creation, and many are becoming first-generation collectors navigating this rapidly evolving luxury landscape.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Edges Higher as Earnings Beat Expectations Despite Middle East Tensions
articles.excerpt: US stocks posted modest gains on Friday as strong corporate results from technology and consumer companies outweighed persistent geopolitical concerns, with the S&P 500 rising for the first time in three sessions.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with US market exposure are navigating a complex landscape where strong corporate earnings compete with Middle East-driven oil price shocks hitting Indian markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Markets Extend Losing Streak to Fifth Session as Oil Prices and Earnings Disappoint
articles.excerpt: The Sensex fell 331 points to 76,060 and the Nifty dropped to 23,767 as Brent crude surging above $100 and weak corporate results from Infosys and IndiGo weighed on sentiment.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with Indian investments are watching their portfolios shrink in a week that wiped roughly 3% off the Sensex; the rupee at 96.55 adds to dollar-denominated losses.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Replaces Expiring Global Tariffs With New 10-12.5% Duties on 60 Trading Partners
articles.excerpt: India faces a 10% levy under Section 301 as the administration pivots from struck-down reciprocal tariffs to forced-labor enforcement, covering 99.4% of U.S. imports.
articles.image_caption: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and U.S. President Donald Trump at a bilateral meeting. India faces a 10% tariff under the new Section 301 trade action covering 60 U.S. trading partners.
articles.nri_angle: Indian textile and apparel exports worth $11 billion annually face new competitive pressure, with India excluded from duty-free quotas granted to regional rivals.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Hits $100 Again as Houthi Threats Open a Second Front in Energy Crisis
articles.excerpt: Brent crude breached the $100-a-barrel threshold for the first time since May as Yemen's Houthis targeted Saudi tankers in the Red Sea, adding a second chokepoint to the Strait of Hormuz disruption and pushing U.S. gas prices above $4 a gallon.
articles.nri_angle: India, a major oil importer sourcing most crude from the Gulf, faces mounting fuel costs and inflation from the dual chokepoint disruption, while Indian-Americans feel the squeeze at the pump.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Power Profit Jumps 42% to Record ₹4,806 Crore as India's Power Appetite Hits New Peaks
articles.excerpt: India's largest private thermal power producer reported its strongest-ever quarter, driven by a scorching summer that pushed national electricity consumption up nearly 9%.
articles.nri_angle: Adani Power's record quarter reflects India's surging energy demand, a key indicator for NRIs tracking infrastructure investment opportunities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India May Open Its ₹17 Lakh Crore Pension System to NRIs and OCIs
articles.excerpt: Draft FEMA rules would let overseas Indians invest in the National Pension System with fully repatriable benefits, as part of a broader push to attract foreign capital.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs and OCIs would gain formal access to India's National Pension System with repatriable retirement benefits under the proposed rules.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
